description:
We're transforming the grocery industry

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

OVERVIEW

The Off Platform team is a collaborative, empowered, and solution-oriented team focused on being customer obsessed with CPG advertisers. The team launches and optimizes off-platform retail media campaigns across Meta, Google, YouTube, Pinterest, and TikTok, and works closely with Sales, Product, Analytics, Sales Enablement, and Advertiser Success. We are looking for an experienced Lead who can manage a team of campaign managers and analysts, ensure quality execution, and drive measurable sales results for CPG partners.

 

ABOUT THE JOB

  • Coach and grow a team of campaign managers and analysts through clear goals, regular feedback, and development plans
  • Set team priorities, balance workload, and build processes that scale
  • Hire and onboard new team members
  • Oversee campaign launch, pacing, and optimization across Meta, Google, YouTube, Pinterest, and TikTok
  • Set QA standards so campaigns launch accurately and deliver against CPG goals
  • Own the accuracy of weekly reporting, monthly billing, and actualized revenue
  • Build reporting frameworks that tie performance to business KPIs, and present clear recommendations
  • Maintain platform best practices, approval workflows, and compliance requirements across campaigns
  • Partner with XFN stakeholders to scope campaign performance readouts and test-and-learn plans
  • Manage external partners, including platform contacts and agencies, by setting briefs, deliverables, approvals, and performance expectations
  • Share results through case studies that show the impact of off-platform ads
  • Test new formats, audiences, and measurement, and turn what works into team best practices, including expanding and developing product offerings
  • Use data, AI and automation to cut manual work
  • Troubleshoot issues independently and escalate risks early to appropriate stakeholders

 

ABOUT YOU

Minimum Qualifications

  • Undergraduate college degree
  • 5+ years of paid social, search, or video media experience
  • 2+ years managing people or leading a team
  • Retail media experience
  • Hands-on experience optimizing campaigns on several of Meta, Google, YouTube, Pinterest, and TikTok
  • Working knowledge of paid platform trends, audience behavior, and platform-specific best practices
  • Ability to analyze data and turn it into clear recommendations at campaign, category, and program level
  • Ability to work independently, problem-solve, manage multiple priorities, assess conflicting needs, and take initiative in a fast-paced environment
  • Confident communication with stakeholders and partners in a cross-functional role
  • High attention to detail, strong project management and organizational skills, and a positive coaching mentality

Preferred Qualifications

  • BA/BS degree in business, advertising, marketing, or a related field
  • Agency or ad-tech experience with brand, retailer, or CPG clients
  • Track record of building extensive QA and optimization processes while managing hundreds of campaigns or initiatives at once
  • Commitment to process and product improvement

#LI-Remote

Instacart provides highly market-competitive compensation and benefits in each location where our employees work. This role is remote and the base pay range for a successful candidate is dependent on their permanent work location. Please review our Flex First remote work policy here.

Offers may vary based on many factors, such as candidate experience and skills required for the role. Additionally, this role is eligible for a new hire equity grant as well as annual refresh grants. Please read more about our benefits offerings here.

For US based candidates, the base pay ranges for a successful candidate are listed below.

$160,000—$169,000 USD
WA
$154,000—$162,500 USD
OR, DE, ME, MA, MD, NH, RI, VT, DC, PA, VA, CO, TX, IL, HI
